data.title: Multiple interview reschedulings or interviewer no-show
data.summary: Interviews are repeatedly postponed, delayed at short notice, or interviewer fails to join scheduled call.

probes.action: Offer clear flexible availability slots and confirm contact details 2 hours prior to the call.
probes.expected_signal: Minimizes scheduling friction and verifies recruiter responsiveness.

non_inferences: Does not imply candidate rejection; frequently reflects interviewer calendar congestion or emergency incidents.
data.content:
# Multiple interview reschedulings or interviewer no-show

Interviews are repeatedly postponed, delayed at short notice, or interviewer fails to join scheduled call.

### Diagnostic Non-Inferences
- Does not imply candidate rejection; frequently reflects interviewer calendar congestion or emergency incidents.
